verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows users operating Flagright through natural-language commands. The MCP server listed in llms.txt sits on the documentation site (docs.flagright.com/_mcp/server) and serves docs to AI clients; it is not shown to control the product. The homepage claims of 'explainable AI agents' and 'AI-native workflows' describe adjacent AI features, not a natural-language command interface. Since this axis fairly applies to a compliance SaaS, the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
